audit_items.proof_trace: `updateMemberTeams` (L537-577) deletes and re-inserts `member_team_relations` for an arbitrary `memberId` without querying the `members` table to verify `deleted_at IS NULL`. The file-level `"use server"` directive (L2) makes this an HTTP-POST-accessible Next.js Server Action, so an admin can invoke it directly with a soft-deleted member's ID, bypassing the UI-layer filter (page.tsx:18) that only surfaces non-deleted members.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An authenticated admin POSTs directly to the `updateMemberTeams` server action endpoint with the `supabase_auth_user_id` of a previously soft-deleted member and desired `teamIds`; the function inserts team relations for the deleted member without objection and triggers a Discord role sync.
